title: Apply Inheritance to children
author: gjabrahams
body_snippet:
Apply inheritance to children is not working. I checked password and panel that is not being inherited.

Version 1.78.2 (Nightly Build 3702) x64

comments.author: cremenescu
comments.snippet: "Apply inheritance to children" does copy the folder's inheritance settings to every connection and folder under it, but nothing saves the connection file afterwards. Inheritance changes, including the ticks in the Inheritance tab of the Config panel, don't trigger the save that follows an edit, and with the default settings 1.78 doesn't save at exit either. So the change lasts until mRemoteNG is closed, unless something else saves the file first: another edit, opening or closing a connection, o...

comments.author: gjabrahams
comments.snippet: When saving (ctrl + s) it is applying. Thanks
